name: spec-constraint-scope
body: A constraint is prose ("X must hold"), and its layer is its scope: a `global.constraint.*` binds the whole durable spec for every APG instance, and a `<tier>.constraint.*` (requirements/domain/solution/implementation) binds that tier. A constraint names no single node — `attaches-to` is not part of the model. The write surface refuses an `attaches-to` property on a new constraint, and `apg spec lint` reports every constraint that carries one. Structure and references hold deterministically at write time; satisfaction of the prose holds by review.
